newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan invites bids for 30,000T basmati rice.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan invites bids for 30,000T basmati rice.

text.p: The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan (RECP) said on Thursday it had invited bids by Sunday for the sale and export of 30,000 tonnes of basmati rice.
"The bids for 30,000 tonnes of basmati rice will be opened on Sunday," a corporation official said.
The RECP sold 10,000 tonnes of basmati rice at $433.75 per tonne FOB through an open auction last month, the official said.
The 1996/97 basmati crop will reach the local markets next month, the official said. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
